formulas.ascii: Per attribute column c over the valid rows: z_ic = (x_ic - mean_c) / s_c with s_c the population standard deviation (0 for a constant column); with standardization rank, z is the average-tie percentile rank (rank - 1) / (n - 1) instead. The reference vector r_c is the mean of the standardized values of the selected reference rows R. Distance d_i = sqrt(sum_c w_c (z_ic - r_c)^2) with non-negative column weights w_c. Rows are ranked by d (lowest row on ties; rank 0 is the most similar, or the least with direction least); invalid, masked and reference rows get no rank and a NaN distance.
